headline: HVANG94 WON BY 0.66 WITH A MINUS-2.90 DEFENSE 🍀🤡

sections.heading: THE LUCKIEST 4-1 IN AMERICA 🍀
sections.body:
Hvang94 is alone in first place at 4-1. Hvang94 also scored 106.58 this week, which was eighth. Eighth. 🤡

The win came by 0.66 points, and it came while his starting defense, the Colts, posted MINUS 2.90. Read that again: he fielded a unit that actively took points off the board and still walked out with a W. A single Hvang94 defensive stop, one, and this is a four-point win instead of a photo finish.

The team is literally named Not good, Just lucky. At some point the self-awareness stops being funny and starts being a threat. LOL.

sections.heading: BROCK PURDY WENT 20.16 IN A BASEBALL CAP ⚰️
sections.body:
jayvang100 lost by 0.66. Brock Purdy scored 20.16 on his bench. Dak Prescott scored 14.64 in his lineup. 💀

That is a 5.52-point swing on a 0.66-point loss. One lineup click, one, and jayvang100 is 3-2 and nobody writes this paragraph. Instead he's 2-3 with the fourth-most points in the league all season (565.92) and a losing record to show for it.

George Pickens went 23.50 and Tyler Warren went 17.90 and it didn't matter, because the quarterback you didn't start had a better Sunday than the one you did. 🧢

sections.heading: DRAKE MAYE DROPPED 47.46 AND THE 0-4 CURSE DIED 🚀
sections.body:
VangMushu came in as the league's last winless team and left with 132.46 and a 31.99 beatdown of KevinVang. Drake Maye went 47.46, the best single performance of Week 5 by twelve points, and nobody else came close. 🔥

The funniest part: Jayden Daniels put up 32.26 on his bench. VangMushu had 79.72 points of quarterback and only needed one of them. He also started Chase Brown for 5.50, which, for a team called I Chase Brown Kids, is a brand crisis.

Saquon Barkley: 0.00. Last week it was 1.50. Progress is not linear. 📉

sections.heading: YOUR KICKER IS BETTER THAN YOUR FIRST-ROUNDER 🦵
sections.body:
Jason Myers kicked 23.00 for Keeneng. That is more than Ja'Marr Chase (16.70), Justin Jefferson (15.80), Christian McCaffrey (15.80), Bijan Robinson (13.80), and Jonathan Taylor (9.70). A guy whose entire job is standing still outscored five teams' entire reason for drafting. 😭

Spencer Shrader hit 21.00 for Tonglue and was the second-best player on a team that lost by 7.55. Ka'imi Fairbairn's 17.00 was Tub89's second-highest score, period. Will Reichard's 16.00 was third on Evz132. Tyler Loop chipped in 14.00 for VangMushu.

Five teams this week were effectively carried, in part, by a man in a clean uniform. Draft capital is a myth. 🎩

sections.heading: THE WAIVER WIRE COST ONE DOLLAR AND THE FREE BIN WON THE WEEK 💸
sections.body:
Total FAAB spent in Week 5: $1. imbackbeech bid a single dollar on Wan'Dale Robinson, who then scored 8.30 on his bench. Evz132 claimed Brian Thomas for $0 after cvang1990 cut him loose; Thomas rewarded the faith with a clean 0.00. Keeneng got Justice Hill for free and benched him for 8.80. 🙃

Meanwhile the actual heroes were lying in the free-agent bin. muahuavang grabbed Jameis Winston off the street and got 31.74 and a three-point win. Hvang94 dropped Kyler Murray for Jacoby Brissett and got 30.78. YMVtheDAD cut the Bills defense for the Jets defense and got 19.80 out of it, which is a sentence that would have gotten you laughed out of 2012.

Best subplot: mouavang86 dropped Nick Folk for Dominic Zvada. Zvada kicked 10.00. KevinVang picked up Folk and got 12.00. You cannot outsmart the kicker carousel, you can only ride it. 🎠

sections.heading: muahuavang FIELDED A PERFECT 0.00 BENCH 🧘
sections.body:
Six bench players. Travis Kelce, Jayden Reed, Tetairoa McMillan, Caleb Williams, Bryce Young, Rico Dowdle. Combined output: 0.00 points. Not 0.00 average. 0.00 total. 🪑

This is either the worst-looking bench in league history or the single most efficient roster-management performance of the season, because he won by 3.05 and left nothing on the table. Jameis Winston went 31.74 and Malik Nabers went 23.60 and that was enough, barely, with Michael Mayer contributing 0.70 at tight end.

Last week McMillan scored 38.20 for this man. This week he scored nothing while sitting down. The lesson, as always, is that there is no lesson. LOL.

sections.heading: TYLER SHOUGH SCORED NEGATIVE POINTS. AT QUARTERBACK. 📉
sections.body:
mouavang86 started Tyler Shough and Shough went MINUS 0.16. In a league where the position average is north of twenty, he found a man who went backwards. Roman Wilson added 0.00 in the same lineup for good measure. 🫠

It wasn't even the worst negative of the week. Hvang94's Colts defense went -2.90 and won him the game. Evz132's Cowboys defense went -0.90 and lost him the game by 47.79. Evz132 also had the Rams defense on his bench at -0.70, which means he owned two defenses that were net-harmful and started the wrong one. 🪦

Puka Nacua's 29.20 deserved better than this. mouavang86 has now been outscored by 610.04 points against on the season, the most in the league. Somebody light a candle.

sections.heading: THE FULL FOURTEEN: NOBODY GETS TO HIDE 🎤
sections.body:
Ranked by what you actually put on the board in Week 5. Fourteen teams, fourteen verdicts, your record doesn't save you here. 📋

1. ChunckyM — 139.20, won by 7.55. Josh Allen's 32.50 and Parker Washington's 27.40 did the heavy lifting, and the Jake Bates pickup paid off immediately with 10.00. Top score in the league, which makes it extra funny that Chris Rodriguez started for 1.60 while Kimani Vidal went 12.10 in sweatpants. 👑

2. Keeneng — 138.32, won by 26.17. Matthew Stafford 33.32 and Derrick Henry 20.50 is a respectable spine, but your second-best player was a kicker, and that's a personality trait now. Starting Juwan Johnson for 3.60 with Kyle Pitts and his 12.70 on the bench is the kind of decision you only get away with when you win by twenty-six. 🦵

3. VangMushu — 132.46, won by 31.99. Drake Maye's 47.46 was the best number anyone posted all week and it dragged a 0-4 team out of the grave. Jayden Daniels sat for 32.26 and Saquon Barkley gave you 0.00, so technically your bench and your namesake running back both quit on you and you still dropped thirty-two on KevinVang. 🚀

4. Tonglue — 131.65, LOST by 7.55. Fourth-most points in the league and nothing to show for it, because you drew the top score. James Cook's 22.30 and a 21.00 from your kicker got you within eight, while A.J. Brown posted a clean 0.00 on your bench and Blake Corum's 14.70 watched Emanuel Wilson go 12.20 in his place. 😤

5. imbackbeech — 129.19, won by 47.79. Biggest beatdown of the week: Jared Goff 34.94, Christian Watson 29.30, and Ja'Marr Chase 16.70 just along for the ride. You started the Bengals defense for 9.35 with the Texans and their 15.70 on your bench, and Harold Fannin's 0.90 at tight end was basically a bye week, and you STILL won by forty-eight. 💣

6. YMVtheDAD — 128.80, won by 34.91. Jahmyr Gibbs 35.20 and Joe Burrow 32.60 is a two-man wrecking crew, and dumping the Bills defense for the Jets defense turned into 19.80 of pure free money. The blemish is Chad Ryland's 2.00 at kicker, which this week was worth less than one-tenth of Jason Myers. 🎯

7. cvang1990 — 112.15, LOST by 26.17. Last week you scored 147.73 and annexed a man; this week you had three starters under 3.30 and got run off the field. Aaron Rodgers 28.00 and Isaiah Likely 26.90 were great, and then Tee Higgins 3.20, Jeremiyah Love 2.20 and Romeo Doubs 2.10 showed up like they'd been called in on their day off. 📉

8. Hvang94 — 106.58, won by 0.66. Eighth-best score in the league, sole possession of first place at 4-1, and a starting defense that scored MINUS 2.90. Jacoby Brissett's 30.78 off the scrap heap and Bucky Irving's 30.50 bailed you out, with Darius Cooper's 14.10 sitting on your bench as insurance you didn't need. 🍀

9. jayvang100 — 105.92, LOST by 0.66. The cruelest loss of the season and it's entirely self-inflicted: Brock Purdy 20.16 on the bench, Dak Prescott 14.64 in the lineup, final margin 0.66. George Pickens' 23.50 and Tyler Warren's 17.90 deserve a better general manager. 🧢

10. KevinVang — 100.47, LOST by 31.99. Jaylen Warren went 33.80 and then the roster just sort of stopped: Rome Odunze 3.50, Jake Ferguson 3.40, Bears defense 1.65. Christian McCaffrey's 15.80 got outscored by Nick Folk's 12.00 by only 3.80, and when your kicker is within four of your best back, the problem isn't the kicker. 🧟

11. muahuavang — 94.39, won by 3.05. A street free agent named Jameis Winston scored 31.74 and won you a football game, with Malik Nabers adding 23.60 and Michael Mayer contributing 0.70 like a polite houseguest. Your six-man bench combined for exactly 0.00, which is either perfect lineup management or a cry for help. 🧘

12. mouavang86 — 93.89, LOST by 34.91. Puka Nacua's 29.20 was wasted on a lineup that included a quarterback at MINUS 0.16 and Roman Wilson at 0.00. You also dropped Nick Folk, watched him kick 12.00 for the guy at tenth, and replaced him with a man who kicked 10.00. 🫠

13. Tub89 — 91.34, LOST by 3.05. You lost by 3.05 and started Dalton Kincaid for 3.20 while Mike Gesicki, who you had just picked up, sat for 6.90. C.J. Stroud's 22.94 and a 17.00 kicker were the top two scorers on a roster that also asked CeeDee Lamb (1.90) and RJ Harvey (0.70) to contribute. 🪦

14. Evz132 — 81.40, LOST by 47.79. Last in points, hit by the week's biggest blowout, and the proud owner of two separate defenses in the red. Mike Evans 22.80 and Trey McBride 17.10 were fine, your kicker was your third-best player at 16.00, and Jacory Croskey-Merritt's 14.20 sat on the bench watching David Montgomery turn in 1.10. 🫡

sections.heading: ONE AT 4-1, SIX AT 3-2, SIX AT 2-3 📊
sections.body:
Hvang94 stands alone at 4-1 with the eighth-best points total in the league, which is the most 2026 thing imaginable. Behind him, a six-car pileup at 3-2: imbackbeech (592.90 PF, most in the league), ChunckyM, cvang1990, YMVtheDAD, Tub89 and KevinVang.

Then a six-team logjam at 2-3 that includes jayvang100, who has the fourth-most points scored all season and a losing record, and Tonglue, Keeneng, mouavang86, muahuavang and Evz132. mouavang86 (610.04) and muahuavang (605.43) have both absorbed over six hundred points against, which is less a schedule than a sentencing. 😵

And VangMushu is 1-4 but no longer 0-4, with the league's lowest PF at 471.10 and the week's best player. Thirteen teams are within two games of each other after five weeks. Nobody is safe, nobody is good, everybody is loud. 📣
